fomod.Name: Oninus Lactis NG
fomod.Author: Orbus Ninus, crajjjj
fomod.Description:
Nipple squirt and milk leak effects, with an API other mods use. The squirt comes from the nipples found on whatever body and outfit the actor wears, the fluid milk leak runs down any body, and every humanoid race (UBE included) can wear the effect.
The installer asks which body slots the squirt should use: 58 and 59 (default), or 54 and 56 for setups where those are taken, such as Devious Devices or GT Softbody.
